findings.title: Rate multiplication may overflow or lose precision
findings.body: `amount_cents * rate` multiplies an `int` by a `Decimal` without converting the integer to `Decimal`, so the result may overflow or lose precision. Convert `amount_cents` to `Decimal` before multiplication to preserve exact arithmetic.

findings.title: Synchronous call in async function
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but it is called synchronously on line 16. This will raise a runtime error when the event loop tries to await the result. Use `await fetch_rate(pair)` instead.

summary.problem: The new async function performs synchronous calls and unsafe arithmetic, risking runtime errors and incorrect results.
summary.done_well: The function clearly documents its purpose and expected inputs/outputs.
